address: 10 place de la Libération, Balma, 31130, France
bio: Run by a couple of 30 - somethings, who believe in hearty, wholesome food, this restaurant fully deserves its resounding success. The chef concocts inspired and balanced recipes using top - quality, market - fresh produce: flawlessly poached egg with cream of leeks and ginger; haddock and carrot pickles. Outstanding value for money....
